edits.text:
Press SELECT to open your inventory.
Use {L}/{R} to choose the Map tab.

Use {Dpad} to move the cursor.
Choose a floor from the floor list.
Press {B} to return.

Press ZL to look through it.
Press {A} to snap a picture.

Press SELECT to open your inventory.
Use {L}/{R} to choose the Masks tab.

Press D-pad Down to wear this mask.
Press it again to return to normal.

Select an item and press {A}.
Press {B} to cancel.{Color:11}

Press SELECT to open your inventory.
Use {L}/{R} to choose the Items tab.

Use {Stick} to select an item.
Press {X} or {Y} to assign it.

For slots I and II, hold ZR
and press {X} or {Y} to assign an item.

Use the same button or button
combination to use the item.
It's easy!

Press SELECT to open your inventory.
Use {L}/{R} to choose Gear and view
what you've collected.

In {Color:1}Event Notes{Color:11}, choose an event
to read its details.

Carried rupees{Color:11} and some items
will be {Color:1}lost{Color:11}.

You can view the minimap{Color:11} in the
bottom right corner. Press ZR +
SELECT to toggle it on or off.

SELECT opens your inventory.
